name: Hanazono Serena no Otoshimono ~sweet memory~
original_name: 花園セレナのおとしもの ～sweet memory～
source:
"Serena. My name is Serena Hanazono...!"

A cat-eared client is seeking the services of your handyman business.
She introduces herself as Serena Hanazono, and she would like you to help her find a lost necklace. 

Movie theatres, cafes, parks, amusement parks...... Together, the two of you search each possible location, but somehow it feels like a fun date......
From a simple client and handyman relationship, your bond gradually deepens.
Will you be able to find Serena's lost item?
And what will become of your relationship...?

Experience a sweet, intimate love story with Serena Hanazono.
Source: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/serena-hanazonos-lost-item-sweet-memory-switch/
translation:
“塞蕾娜。我的名字是塞蕾娜·花园……！”

一位猫耳客户正在寻求你的勤杂工业务的服务。
她介绍自己为Serena Hanazono，她希望你能帮助她找到一条丢失的项链。

电影院、咖啡馆、公园、游乐园……两人一起寻找每一个可能的地点，但不知怎的，却感觉像是一次有趣的约会……
从简单的客户和勤杂工的关系，你们的关系逐渐加深。
你能找到瑟琳娜丢失的物品吗？
你们的关系将会怎样……？

与Serena Hanazono体验甜蜜、亲密的爱情故事。
资料来源：https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/serena-hanazonos-lost-item-sweet-memory-switch/
